item.name: Fuse Machine
item.cardSummary: The original fusion system combined a set of Brainrots into one result, with the output shaped by the submitted rarities and values. Its 2026 return belongs to this same machine lineage.
item.inputsOrCost: Four Brainrots plus a cash fee calculated after the inputs were placed
item.resultOrEffect: Produced one fusion-pool Brainrot after a rarity-based timer, with a chance to inherit input traits or mutations.
item.howToUse: Place four Brainrots, review the displayed outcomes and fee, start the fuse, then collect the result when the timer ends.

item.name: Craft Machine
item.cardSummary: The base crafting system exchanged exact recipe ingredients for a guaranteed listed Brainrot. It replaced the first Fuse Machine before the Halloween rotation.
item.inputsOrCost: Two to four recipe-specific Brainrots
item.resultOrEffect: Crafted the selected recipe's Brainrot instead of rolling a random fusion result.
item.howToUse: Choose a recipe, place every required Brainrot, start the craft, and collect the result after its timer.

item.name: Witch Fuse
item.cardSummary: This Halloween fuse variant replaced the Craft Machine with a spooky reward pool and revised fusion rules. It was later replaced by the Brainrot Dealer.
item.inputsOrCost: Four Brainrots
item.resultOrEffect: Produced one Witch Fuse Brainrot after a timed fusion, with possible trait or mutation inheritance.
item.howToUse: Place four Brainrots, check the possible outcomes, start the fuse, and return when the timer finishes.

item.name: Santa's Fuse
item.cardSummary: The Christmas fuse used the familiar four-input format with its own festive reward pool. It followed the Brainrot Trader during the holiday update sequence.
item.inputsOrCost: Four Brainrots
item.resultOrEffect: Produced one Brainrot from the Santa's Fuse pool after a timed fusion.
item.howToUse: Place four Brainrots, start the festive fuse, and reveal the resulting Brainrot after the timer.

item.name: Divine Fuse
item.cardSummary: The Update 41 fuse variant replaced the returning Fuse Machine with a separate Divine-themed outcome pool. Its results remain historical after the machine's removal.
item.inputsOrCost: Four Brainrots
item.resultOrEffect: Produced one Brainrot from the Divine Fuse lineup after a timed fusion.
item.howToUse: Place four Brainrots, review the possible Divine Fuse outcomes, start the process, and collect the result after the timer.

item.name: Cyber Craft Machine
item.cardSummary: The Cyber update brought back recipe crafting with a themed machine and a dedicated lineup. Better output rarities used longer crafting timers.
item.inputsOrCost: Recipe-specific Brainrots
item.resultOrEffect: Crafted the chosen Cyber recipe after a rarity-based timer.
item.howToUse: Select a recipe, submit every required Brainrot, wait for the craft timer, and reveal the finished Brainrot.

item.name: Summer Fuse
item.cardSummary: The Update 52 seasonal fuse reused the core fusion loop with a beach-themed lineup. Its detailed result roster belongs on the separate Fuse Machine collection.
item.location: Middle of the map near the Shop
item.inputsOrCost: Four Brainrots
item.resultOrEffect: Produced one Summer Fuse Brainrot, with the possible result influenced by the submitted Brainrots.
item.howToUse: Place four Brainrots, review the possible result, start the fuse, and carry the finished Brainrot back to your base.

item.name: Brainrot Dealer
item.cardSummary: This short-lived shop sold a globally shared stock of special Brainrots for in-game cash. Fast sellouts led to its replacement by the server-based Brainrot Trader.
item.inputsOrCost: In-game cash; some stock also had Robux purchase options
item.resultOrEffect: Purchased the selected in-stock Brainrot and sent it toward the buyer's base.
item.howToUse: Open the dealer during a stock window and buy an available Brainrot before the shared supply sells out.

item.name: Brainrot Trader
item.cardSummary: This server-based exchange replaced the global-stock Dealer. Its rotating offers asked for existing Brainrots in return for a listed machine-exclusive result.
item.inputsOrCost: Offer-specific sets of existing Brainrots
item.resultOrEffect: Exchanged the required inputs for the Brainrot shown in a server-side offer.
item.howToUse: Check the rotating offers, choose a target, submit one complete requirement set, and confirm the exchange.

item.name: Santa's Shop
item.cardSummary: The Christmas shop sold holiday Brainrots from a limited stock using event currency or Robux. It belongs to the retired seasonal shop rotation.
item.inputsOrCost: Gold Elves or Robux, depending on the offer
item.resultOrEffect: Purchased the chosen holiday Brainrot when that offer was in stock.
item.howToUse: Open the shop, choose an available Brainrot, and pay with the currency shown on its offer.

item.name: Los Traders
item.cardSummary: The Update 57 trader system exchanges older Brainrots and cash for a rotating pool of Secret rewards. Stock is shared and refreshes on a regular cycle.
item.location: Middle of the map beside Summer Fuse
item.inputsOrCost: Offer-specific Brainrots plus the listed in-game cash cost
item.resultOrEffect: Exchanged the submitted requirements for the listed Los Traders Brainrot while stock remained.
item.howToUse: Check each stock refresh, choose an available offer, submit its Brainrots and cash, then protect the result as it travels to your base.

item.name: Duels Machine
item.cardSummary: The duel system let two players wager Brainrots and fight in a separate match. The winner received the Brainrot placed at stake by the opponent.
item.inputsOrCost: A Brainrot wager from each player
item.resultOrEffect: Started a private duel and transferred the losing player's wager to the winner.
item.howToUse: Challenge another player, choose a Brainrot to wager, accept the matchup, and win the duel to claim the opponent's stake.

item.name: Trade Machine
item.cardSummary: The official trade system replaced trust-based swaps with a two-sided confirmation flow. The physical machine was later removed when trading moved to a permanent menu button.
item.location: Center of the map beside the conveyor belt
item.inputsOrCost: Brainrots offered by both players
item.resultOrEffect: Transferred the accepted offers between the two players after both confirmed the trade.
item.howToUse: Find or search for a player, add Brainrots to each side, mark the offer ready, and complete the final confirmation.

item.name: Egg Incubator
item.cardSummary: The Easter incubator held an Egg or Egg Lucky Block while trait events ran. It offered a passive, lower-chance route for adding active traits to the stored egg.
item.inputsOrCost: One Egg or Egg Lucky Block
item.resultOrEffect: Gave the stored egg a small chance to receive traits that were active during events.
item.howToUse: Place an Egg or Egg Lucky Block in the incubator and leave it stored while eligible trait events are active.

item.name: Rainbow Machine
item.cardSummary: The game's first machine consumed Gold Brainrots to start a temporary Rainbow event. The original machine was removed, although admins can still trigger the event without it.
item.inputsOrCost: Twenty-five Gold Brainrots
item.resultOrEffect: Started a timed event that increased the chance of Rainbow-mutated Brainrots appearing.
item.howToUse: Submit the required Gold Brainrots to fill the machine and activate the Rainbow event.

item.name: Bubblegum Machine
item.cardSummary: This event machine accepted Candy Brainrots to trigger the Bubblegum event. The machine was retired, but the event can still appear through admin-controlled rotations.
item.location: In front of the Brainrot spawn
item.inputsOrCost: Ten Candy Brainrots
item.resultOrEffect: Activated an event that could apply the Bubblegum trait to Brainrots.
item.howToUse: Submit the required Candy Brainrots to activate the Bubblegum event when the machine was available.

item.name: Advent Calendar
item.cardSummary: The Christmas calendar awarded daily gifts and streak rewards to eligible players. Missed daily rewards could be recovered before the event ended.
item.inputsOrCost: At least one rebirth; missed rewards could be recovered for Robux
item.resultOrEffect: Granted the day's gift and tracked holiday login-streak rewards.
item.howToUse: Join during the event, open the calendar, and claim each unlocked daily reward before the seasonal window closed.

item.name: Admin Machine
item.cardSummary: The original Admin Machine was an hourly event board that rolled a reward, event, and luck multiplier. Later themed Admin Machines reused this same system.
item.inputsOrCost: No player input; rolls followed the admin or hourly event schedule
item.resultOrEffect: Selected Brainrots or Lucky Blocks, a map event, and a server luck multiplier.
item.howToUse: Watch the board's countdown and event result, then react to the reward, event, and luck effects it activates.

item.name: New Year's Machine
item.cardSummary: The New Year's Eve machine consumed earning power from submitted Brainrots to fill an event meter. A completed meter launched the 2026 event and its reward spawn.
item.inputsOrCost: A Brainrot earning more than $50K/s, followed by more Brainrots until the meter filled
item.resultOrEffect: Started the 2026 event and spawned one of its New Year's Brainrots.
item.howToUse: Insert an eligible Brainrot, continue adding Brainrots until the progress meter reaches full, and collect the event spawn.

item.name: Cupid's Machine
item.cardSummary: The Valentine's machine matched pairs of Brainrots for a chance at themed rewards. Its pool included Heart Lucky Blocks and exclusive Valentine Brainrots.
item.inputsOrCost: A supported pair of Brainrots and the displayed cash requirement
item.resultOrEffect: Rolled a Valentine's reward from the eligible pair, with a possible no-reward result.
item.howToUse: Place a valid matching Brainrot in each tube, confirm the exchange, and reveal the machine's result.
